tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' bral bzhugs so//

'khor 'das dbyer med gnyug ma mchog /rang rig bla ma la btud nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' bral bri// phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i/ rtsa rlung bcas pa rtags thon nas// rang sems gzhi rtsa gcod pa ni// dben par bsam gtan chos bdun dang*// ldan pa legs par 'khod nas cing*// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong dang*// rang rig chos sku ngo sprad pa'o// dang po zhi gnas bsgom pa la'ang*// mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa'o// dang po mtshan bcas bsgom pa la// dag dang ma dag rnam gnyis so// dang po ma dag mtshan bcas ni// rang mdun shing bu rde'u 'am// dkar nag la sogs kha dog can// dmigs pa'i rten du rab bzhag nas| |sems kyi rgyu ba rgyun bcad nas// ma yeng dmigs rten de la gtad// 'phro rgod la sogs ci byung yang*// rbad kyi bcad nas bsgom par bya| |'di la 'das pa'i rjes mi 'brang*// ma 'ongs rtog pa'i sngon mi bsu// da lta'i 'di bya 'di byed sogs// 'gyu ba gang shar 'phro bcad nas// yeng med ngang du rgyun bskyang ngo// thun dang po'o// gnyis pa dag pa'i mtshan can ni// mdun du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sam// yi dam la sogs lha yi sku// bris 'bur gang rung bshams pa la// ma yeng sems gtad legs par bsgom// de sogs gnas pa'i thabs bya zhing*// 'gyu ba bkag la 'bad de bsgom// thun gnyis pa'o| |gnyis pa mtshan ma med pa la// rlung can dang ni rlung med gnyis// dang po rlung can bsgom pa ni// rang gi snying nang 'od lnga las// grub pa'i thig le sran ma tsam// gsal stong 'dzin med 'od du 'bar// de la sems gtad bum can rlung*// bzung nas rtog tshogs kun 'gags nas// ma yeng sgom la 'bad par bya'o// thun gsum pa'o// gnyis pa rlung med bsgom pa ni// rtog pa gang du'ang ma gtad par// 'gyu ba'i tshogs kun rab bkag nas// rtog med gnas pa'i ngang dag tu// ji tsam gnas pa'i bar du bzhag

/de ltar gnas cha sgrub pa'i thabs// zhi gnas lam 'di nyams blang tshe// gnas pa dang po ri gzar gyi// rbab 'dra 'gyu ba sngar bas kyang*// rgod pa lta bu 'byung ba ni// sngon chad 'gyu ba kha yan du// song zhing da lta 'gyu dran la// bkag pas ngos zin rtags yin no// gnas pa gnyis pa chu bo ni// dal gyis 'bab ltar sems dal ba// cung zad gnas cha rnyed pa'i rtags// gnas pa gsum pa mar me ni// rlung gis ma bskyod pa bzhin du// lhan ne gnas pa de nyid ni// 'di ni zhi gnas yongs su brjod// 'on kyang gnas cha yod tsam las| |ha cang 'thug cing ro lta bu// tshogs drug 'gags pa ltar byed pa// zhi gnas lteng po zhes bya ste// de ni dud 'gro 'gog pa dang*// gzugs med khams su gol srid pas// spos kyis dri dang skad dal pos// thabs kyis sad par bya ba gces// thun bzhi pa'o// gnyis pa lhag mthong bsgrub pa la// sems kyi gzhi rtsa gcod pa ni// sems zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni| |dang po gang nas byung brtag cing*// rgyu rkyen ci las 'di byung dang*// bar du gnas sa gang du ste// lus kyi phyi nang stod smad dang*// mig sogs gang du gnas brtag cing*// tha ma 'gro ba gang du gda'// de sogs byung gnas 'gro gsum brtag /thun lnga pa'o// slar yang sems zhes bya ba 'di// gzugs su grub bam ma grub brtag /gal te ma grub snyam pa na/ */ gzugs med na ni sems zhes pa'i// ming 'di gang la btags pa brtag /gal te gzugs su grub snyam na// gzugs dbyibs ci 'dra kha dog gang*// de sogs gzhi rtsa bcad la brtag |thun drug pa'o// de nas rnam rtog la sogs pa'i// 'gyu ba breng breng 'di nyid dang*// sems kyi ngo bo gcig gam brtag /gcig na sems dang 'gyu ba gnyis// so sor snang ba 'di ci yin// mi gcig na ni sems gnyis shig /yod par 'gyur ram legs par brtag /sems dang lus gnyis gtso gang che// lus gtso na ni shi ba'i tshe// sems dang bral tshe lus 'di nyid// ro yis don byed ci la nus// sems gtso na ni lus med na// sems kyis don byed ci ltar nus// de sogs brdar sha bcad par bya// thun bdun pa'o// mig gis gzugs mthong dbang po 'di// sems kyis mthong ngam mig gis mthong*// mig gis mthong na shi ba'i tshe// ro yi mig gis mi mthong zhing*// sems kyis mthong na shi ba'i tshe// bar do'i rnam shes nang khul du// rigs mthun lha mig ma gtogs pa// gzhan gyis mi mthong rgyu mtshan ci// de bzhin rna bas sgra thos dang*// sna yi dri dang lce'i ro dang*// lus kyi reg bya la sogs pa// tshor ba lnga po dbang lnga dang*// sems nyid gang gtso brtag pa sogs// gzhi rtsa gcod la 'bad pa gnad// thun brgyad pa'o// mi rtog gnas pa'i mod nyid las// dal gyis 'gyu ba breng nge 'byung*// gnas 'gyu rig gsum ming btags kyang*// gnas dang 'gyu ba rig gsum la// sems la khyad par 'dug mi 'dug

/med na gnas tshe mi rtog cing*// 'gyu tshe rtog pa du ma 'char// rig pa'i ngo bo 'gyu ba ste// gnas dang 'gyu ba khyad med na// 'gro dang bsdad la'ang khyad med phyir// dper na 'gyu ba sprin lta bu| |gnas pa nam mkha'i khams lta bu// de phyir de la khyad med na// shes bya'i chos kun 'gal bar 'gyur// gal te khyad gcig 'dug snyam na// sems las gzhan pa'i gnas 'gyu dang*| |rig la khyad par ci 'dug blta// thun dgu pa'o// mnyam bzhag byas tshe gang du yang*// mi 'phro gnas pa bde sang nge*// bde ba'i ngang nas gsal ba'i mdangs// rig rig tur tur gsal lhang nge*// gsal ba'i ngo bo mi rtog pa// cham gdal ngang du lhod de ba// de la bde gsal mi rtog pa// ces pa'i ming btags sgom go chod// 'on kyang de gsum la chags na// gol phyir de gsum ngo bor blta// bde dang sdug la khyad 'dug gam// gsal dang mi gsal khyad 'dug gam// gsal dang sgrib la khyad 'dug gam// rtog dang mi rtog khyad 'dug gam// 'dug na dbye ba gang gis 'byed// bde dang mi bde rnam gnyis po// bde ba dga' 'am bde ba sdug /mi bde dga' 'am mi bde sdug /dga' sdug byed pa su yis byas| |gal te khyad mi 'dug snyam na// gang ltar byas kyang bde ba dang*// bying rmugs med par gsal ba dang*// 'gyu 'phro med par mi rtog pa// gsum la khyad par ches che bas// des na de la brtag byas nas// khyad mi 'dug na so so ru// ming btags dgos pa ci yi phyir// gzhig pa 'jug pa shin tu gces// thun bcu pa'o// gzhan yang rnam rtog ngo bo dang*// sems kyi ngo bo gcig mi gcig /gcig na sems dang rnam rtog tu// dbye ba'i tha snyad su yis btags// mi gcig snyam na rnam rtog rnams// sems las 'byung bar mi 'dug gam// sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid// yin na nam mkha' dang mtshungs phyir// mkha' la 'gyu dran rtog tshogs rnams// yod ces khas len su yis nus// sems nyid stong pa min zhe na// dngos por grub pa su yis mthong*// stong pa yin min gnyis ka min// zhe na de yang gnyis 'dzin can// yin phyir the tshom bsgom pa la// nyams len yid rton su yis rung*// gnyis ka yin min gnyis ka yang*// min zhes smra na'ang don gyi sar// yid gnyis 'dzin pa'i sgom chen te// des ni sa lam ci phyir bgrod// de sogs gang zag las dang po// rnams la yin min la sogs dang*// 'gal rtags rgyu mtshan du ma nas// blta ru bcug cing gang mthong na// so sor bshad cing 'jug tu bcug

/gsum pa ni/ mdor na slob ma rang nyid kyis// 'khor 'das rtsa ba sems nyid de// sems ni yod pa'ang ma yin zhing*// med pa yang ni ma yin pa// yod med gnyis ka'ang ma yin zhing*// gnyis ka min pa'ang ma yin par// mtha' bzhi bral ba'i sems nyid ni// gdod nas 'od gsal lhun grub pa// ma byas byar med ngang gis grub// snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun// don dam grub pa med pa'i phyir// yod ces bya ba'i mtha' dang bral// chos rnams kun rdzob bden pa ru// med bzhin snang bar grub pa'i phyir// med ces bya ba'i mtha' dang bral// kun rdzob don dam bden pa gnyis// mnyam nyid dbyings su gcig pa'i phyir// gnyis ka min pa'i mtha' las 'das// bden gnyis snying po lhun grub sems// gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du| |'gyur med rtag brtan chos kyi sku+u// yin phyir gnyis ka min pa'ang min// mtha' las 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid// shar grol 'dzin med rjen lhang nge*// rang rang ngo bo stong pa ni// rnam rtog ngo bo ka dag gi// chos sku mtha' bral ye nas yin// de yi rang mdangs ma 'gags pa// gsal shing sgrib med dwangs sang nge// ngo bo mthong la longs spyod rdzogs// gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gyur ba// longs sku nges pa lnga dang ldan// de yi rang rtsal phyogs med du// sna tshogs 'char sgo du mar snang*// gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs su// bsgyur zhing 'char ba sprul pa'i sku// de dag sku gsum rang chas su// yod par rtogs na mngon 'tshang rgya// sku gsum rang la yod bzhin du// phyi nas 'tshol zhing logs su sems// 'khor 'das gzhi lam 'bras bu dang*// lta sgom spyod pa la sogs pa// du mar bshad cing du mar snang*// 'dzin stangs spyod yul sna tshogs pa// rang sems las gzhan med pa'i phyir// kun byed rgyal po rang sems kyi// rtsa ba rtogs na kun shes 'gyur// de phyir rang sems rtogs pa gces// rang sems rtsa ba ma bcad par// a 'thas ther zug grub pa'i mtha'// bden zhen gcig tu 'dzin pa dang*// rang sems ma rtogs lta ba'i phreng*// rang gzhan stong pa'i rnam gzhag 'ga'// dgag sgrub rnam rtog phreng ba'i tshogs// yi ger bris pa'i glegs bam rnams// bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// chos kun dngos gcig ma rtogs par// shed can bdag 'dzin can 'ga' yis// rnam rtog dran rgya'i tshig phreng gis// je mang btang ba'i thal phyir sogs// rtog ges gzhal ba'i lta ba de// dper na dug sbrang mchu ring gis// rgya mtsho'i mching dbang rtogs 'dod 'dra// gzhan yang tha snyad tshig phreng dang*// ngag 'chal tshig sna'i rna thos dang*// dpe klog zhal gdams blta ba dang*// sgom chen gzhan gyi zer zlos kyi// blo brid mgo bo ma 'khor bar// rang gis rang sems la bltas shing*// gzhig pa bcug pas mthong bar 'gyur// de tshe rang ngo mthong bas na// gang shar ngo bo skyong ba yi// tha mal shes pa dus der mthong*// de tshe de la nges shes dang*// yin lugs ngo sprod gsal bar gdab// de nas rim bzhin rtse gcig dang*// spros bral ro gcig sgom med sogs// brjod du med pa rjod byed kyis// brtags pas don rnams rim gyis mthong*// rim bzhin mthong tshe ngo sprod gdab// 'dzin med mtha' bral khyab gdal dngos// nam mkha' lta bu'i lta ba dang*// gang ltar byas kyang rgyun mi 'chad// chu bo lta bu'i sgom pa dang*// rtsis gdab rjes med spyod pa'i mchog

/chu la ral gri bsnun lta bu// chags zhen ngar 'dzin med pa dang*// tha snyad tshig la mi zhen cing*// 'dzin med yeng med mi 'dor bar// dus kun sems la rgyang so tshugs// 'jig rten las la ma chags shing*// rang nyid 'bad brtson che ba dang*// kun nas dman sa 'dzin pa dang*// dad pa che zhing dam tshig gtsang*// mos gus gdung shugs che ba dang*// mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa dang*// dben gnas lung stong 'grim pa dang*// tshe 'di'i ltos zhen chung ba dang*// phyi ma'i bde ba sgrub pa dang*// gzhan phan sems bskyed ldan pa dang*// 'khor gsum yongs dag bsngo ba dang*/ dkon mchog rnam gsum skyabs song dang*// rgyu 'bras rtsis gdab zhib pa dang*// ham stobs byung rgyal med pa dang*| |zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs lnga// gang skyes mgo bo gnon pa rnams// lam zab 'di la shin tu gces// gzhan yang zab mo'i gdams pa rnams/ brgyud pa gong mas byin brlabs shing*// smin grol gdams pa'i bcud ldan pa'i// slob dpon myong ba can dag gi// gsung gi gsang ba la brten pa// dgos pa kun gyi gtso bor mchis| |de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po zhes// chos 'khor rnam gsum dgongs pa'i bcud// gcig tu dril ba'i gdams pa 'di// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon gcig pu// mtshan dkar rin chen dpal zhes pa'i// gsung gi gsang ba rdo rje'i tshig /ji bzhin 'khrul ba dang bral zhing*// lung rig rtog ge smra mchu yi// ngan lhad blos byas ring spangs nas// dag gsal don ldan tshig gi phreng*// dbur stod 'bri gung phyogs son pa'i// skyu ra chos kyi grags pa yis// bris pa'i rnam dkar dge ba rnams// pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro thams cad// rdzogs byang 'thob phyir bdag bsngo'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
